final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM all_star AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(row_count) AS total FROM country_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.death_country, c.row_count, 1.0 * c.row_count / t.total AS share FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total_count AS t), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.death_country, s.row_count, s.share, s.share - av.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS av WHERE s.share > av.avg_share ORDER BY s.death_country
